column1: # ESP-IDF partition table for the 4 MiB ESP32-C6 / ESP32-H2 zigbee-rs devkits.
# The table itself lives at 0x8000 and is 3072 (0xC00) bytes long; the second
# stage bootloader occupies 0x0..0x8000. 0xB000..0x10000 is intentionally left
# unmapped (that is where ESP-IDF would put `nvs`/`phy_init`
# `zbnv` covers the last 64 KiB. The log-structured Zigbee NV storage keeps its
# two 4 KiB pages in the last 8 KiB of that partition (0x3FE000..0x400000) —
# the same addresses used before the table existed
# does not move a single byte of joined-network state.
